---
title: "Research"
description-meta: "Research by Seng Yee Sin on historical legacies, political violence, and intergroup relations."
---

My research examines how historical institution legacy shapes contemporary violence and inter-group violence. A complete list is on my [CV](/media/cv.pdf).

## Work in Progress

“Colonial Minority Power Distortion and Post-Colonial Violence in Indonesia”

“British Malaya Counterinsurgency Legacy and Post-Authoritarian Consolidation”

“How Chinese FDI Shapes Ethnic Dynamics in Southeast Asia” with [Hanzhang Liu](https://hanzhang-liu.org)

“Marketing Boards and Agricultural Distortions in Developing Countries” with [Jheng, Shao-Yu](https://sites.google.com/view/jheng-shao-yu) 

“Ethnic Violence and Legitimacy in Autocratic Regime, Malaysia 1969 Ethnic Conflict” with [Hilary Izatt](https://www.binghamton.edu/political-science/people/profile.html?id=hizatt)
